model: word + character TF-IDF; LinearSVC(C=1.0); metadata appended to request text
validation_protocol: Chronological holdout: fit through 2026-04-30; validate 2026-05-01 through 2026-06-30
important_limit: Validation measures agreement with historical initial queue labels, not correctness against independent ground-truth routing outcomes.
policy_guardrail: When the model predicts Consumables but explicit product-fault language appears, route to Repairs. This rule was evaluated on the same chronological holdout.
